title: RDK-B Core Broadband Hardware Compatibility Metrics
description: Per-profile minimum CPU/RAM/flash and required peripheral hardware, published for consumption by the Core RDK Broadband docs site UI and related tooling.

specVersion.description: Version of this JSON schema (semantic version), e.g. "1.0".

profileName.description: Human-readable profile name for display, matching the Hardware Compatibility Specification Section 1.1.

family.description: SoC core family, e.g. "Cortex-A73". This is the reference-device value; the normative architecture requirement is cpu.architecture, not this field.

minClockGHz.description: Minimum sustained clock speed in GHz.

name.description: Name of the validated reference device, e.g. "BPI-R4".

soc.description: Optional. SoC used on the reference device.

buildBranch.description: Optional. Source branch used for the validated build.

peripheralsRef.description: Relative path to this profile's separate peripherals file (see peripherals.schema.json), under the peripherals/ subfolder using the convention 'peripherals/<profileId>.peripherals.json', e.g. "peripherals/ethwan-wifi-router.peripherals.json". An array of self-describing blocks (WAN, Wi-Fi, Storage Interface, etc.) the UI renders generically -- adding a new block, or a new detail field within one, requires only a JSON change, never a page-generator code change. Kept out-of-line, matching memoryFootprintRef/cpuUtilizationRef/flashLayoutRef.

validationStatus.description: Validation state of the values in this document, per the Reference Device Validation Methodology.

lastValidated.description: Optional. ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the most recent validation pass. Under validationStatus: "partial", this means "last tested" — the date some subset of values were exercised on the reference device — not that every field in this file was confirmed at its exact stated value.

memoryFootprintRef.description: Optional. Relative path to this profile's separate memory-footprint file (see memory-footprint.schema.json), under the memory-footprint/ subfolder using the convention 'memory-footprint/<profileId>.memory-footprint.json', e.g. "memory-footprint/ethwan-wifi-router.memory-footprint.json". Answers 'what consumes the RAM minimum'. Kept out-of-line so per-process RSS data can be updated as components are profiled without revising this file.

flashLayoutRef.description: Optional. Relative path to this profile's separate flash-layout file (see flash-layout.schema.json), under the flash-layout/ subfolder using the convention 'flash-layout/<profileId>.flash-layout.json', e.g. "flash-layout/ethwan-wifi-router.flash-layout.json". Answers 'what is the flash layout / what consumes the flash minimum'. Kept out-of-line so partition sizing can be refined as real bring-up data comes in.

cpuUtilizationRef.description: Optional. Relative path to this profile's separate cpu-utilization file (see cpu-utilization.schema.json), under the cpu-utilization/ subfolder using the convention 'cpu-utilization/<profileId>.cpu-utilization.json', e.g. "cpu-utilization/ethwan-wifi-router.cpu-utilization.json". Answers 'what consumes the CPU minimum'. Kept out-of-line so per-process utilization data can be added as components are profiled.

regionalRefs.description: Optional. Relative paths to this profile's separate per-region regional files (see regional.schema.json), under the regional/ subfolder using the convention 'regional/<profileId>.<regionId>.json', e.g. ["regional/ethwan-wifi-router.us.json"]. Answers 'can this hardware be deployed in a given region' (Hardware Compatibility Specification Section 7). One entry per region profiled; kept out-of-line since regional/certification status changes on its own timeline independent of this file.

supportedTypes.description: Flash technologies this requirement permits in production, e.g. ["eMMC", "UFS", "SPI-NAND"]. This is the REQUIREMENT, not necessarily what the reference device in validationEvidence was tested on.

filesystem.description: Optional. Filesystem used on flash — "ext4", "squashfs", or "EROFS" for eMMC/UFS; "UBI/UBIFS" for SPI-NAND. MUST be compatible with requiredStorage.supportedTypes; UBI/UBIFS MUST NOT be paired with eMMC or UFS.

validationEvidence.description: Optional. What was actually exercised on the reference device, distinct from the requiredStorage requirement itself — answers whether production storage technology was validated or a stand-in medium was used.

storageType.description: Storage technology ACTUALLY present on the reference/validation device, e.g. "SD" — may differ from requiredStorage.supportedTypes (the production requirement).

productionStorageValidated.description: True only if the reference device's actual storageType is itself one of requiredStorage.supportedTypes — i.e., production storage technology (not a stand-in medium like SD) was exercised.
